<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 13"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Camoflage Coat](/Feats.aspx?ID=5337) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Centaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=747" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 33

**Prerequisites**
[Mottle-Coat Centaur](/Heritages.aspx?ID=295) heritage

</column>

---

You've learned to use your natural camouflage to your advantage, enhancing your ability to blend with your surroundings through careful movements and additional markings or attire. In your selected terrain, you can [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) or [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405) without cover or being concealed.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Fledgling Flight](/Feats.aspx?ID=2649) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Strix" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=342" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Ancestry Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=74) pg. 136

**Frequency**
once per round

</column>

---

You can fly through the air in short bursts. You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet for this movement. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

<title level="2">Fledgling Flight leads to...</title>
[Juvenile Flight](/Feats.aspx?ID=2653)
_source.name: Fledgling Flight
